title: Audit logging: burst config changes + policy decisions (who/what/when)
author: Kaitlyn Nguyen
description:
Context
Burst introduces customer-configurable guardrails and policy-driven admission. For pilot + GA readiness, we need auditable trails for: (1) changes to burst-related tenant config and (2) policy decisions that admit/deny burst, including attribution (who/what/when) and correlation IDs.

This PR adds audit logging in two places:
1) Control plane (config writes): emits AuditEvent records when burst config objects are created/updated/deleted via API/Console/admin tooling.
2) Policy evaluation path (read-time decisions): emits AuditDecision records when the burst policy engine makes an allow/deny decision, including the evaluated limits and resulting reason code.

Key behaviors / guarantees
- Config change events are emitted synchronously with the write transaction commit (best-effort publish with retry + fallback to local spool) and include actor identity.
- Policy decision events are emitted on the policy service after evaluation; they are rate-limited to avoid log floods during high QPS (details below).
- Events include: timestamp, actor (service/user), tenant_id, region, pool_id (if applicable), request_id/trace_id, decision (allow/deny), deny_reason_code, and a stable config snapshot hash.
- Sensitive fields: we never log raw API keys, prompt content, or customer metadata beyond tenant_id/org_id. For config changes we log a redacted diff (field names + old/new scalar values where safe) and hashes for larger blobs.

Implementation details
- New proto: audit.v1.AuditEvent and audit.v1.AuditDecision.
- New shared library: pkg/auditlog with helpers for actor extraction (JWT subject, admin impersonation, service identity) and consistent field redaction.
- Control plane integration: controlplane/tenants/burst_config_service.go now wraps mutating endpoints with auditlog.EmitConfigChange(ctx, ...).
- Policy integration: policy/burst/evaluator.go emits AuditDecision on every deny + sampled allow (default 1/1000) to keep volume bounded.
- Routing correlation: uses existing x-redwood-request-id and traceparent. If missing, policy service generates a request_id and returns it in response headers.
- Sink: audit events publish to the existing internal topic "audit-events" (same infra used by RBAC policy bundle changes). Indexing tags added for tenant_id and event_type.

Sampling / rate limiting
- Deny decisions: 100% logged (needed for support + incident forensics).
- Allow decisions: sampled with configurable probability (config key: audit.burst.allow_sample_rate; default 0.001).
- Additional circuit: hard cap per-tenant per-minute for allow logs to prevent outliers (default 120/min). When exceeded, we emit a single "suppressed" counter event.

Testing
- Unit tests for redaction and actor extraction.
- Integration test covers config update -> emitted AuditEvent contains expected actor/tenant + redacted diff.
- Policy test covers deny reasons (NOT_ENABLED, COOLDOWN_ACTIVE, REGION_NOT_ELIGIBLE, POOL_SATURATED, LIMIT_EXCEEDED) and verifies 100% deny logging.

Rollout notes
- Feature gated by config flag: audit.burst.enabled (default off). Enabled in staging only after merge; production enablement tracked separately.
- No customer-visible behavior changes.

Refs: ENG-4833

controlplane: emit audit events for burst config writes
policy: emit audit decisions for burst admit/deny
tests: add integration coverage and golden fixtures
docs: internal README for audit fields + sinks
review_conversation:
2025-07-22 10:14 Kaitlyn Nguyen (author): Adding audit logging for burst config changes + policy decisions. Denies are 100% logged; allows are sampled.

2025-07-22 13:02 Marcus Lin (Security): Looks good directionally. Two asks: (1) ensure we never log raw JWTs or auth headers (even in debug). (2) For config diffs, avoid logging customer-provided strings verbatim (tenant display names, notes). Can we do field-level allowlist?

2025-07-22 13:28 Kaitlyn Nguyen: Yep—good catches. I’ll switch diff logging to an allowlist of burst limit fields only (tps/concurrency/cooldown/pool eligibility), and hash any string fields.

2025-07-23 09:11 Jordan Lee (Policy): For decision events, can we include the evaluated effective limits (after defaults/inheritance) and the limiter key used? Helps debug when defaults are surprising.

2025-07-23 09:44 Kaitlyn Nguyen: Added effective_limit fields + limiter_key (tenant_id|region|pool). Also added a regression test for default inheritance.

2025-07-23 15:27 Allison Grant (Observability): Concern about cardinality. If pool_id and model_id are both tags, this could explode. Proposal: keep pool_id in the structured payload but do not tag/index it; only tag tenant_id + event_type + decision.

2025-07-23 16:05 Kaitlyn Nguyen: Agreed. Updated emitter: pool_id stays in payload, not in tags. Only tenant_id + event_type + decision + region are indexed.

2025-07-24 11:38 Sean Gallagher (SRE): Can we guarantee deny logs are emitted even if the sink is down? At minimum, local spool with bounded disk + alertable metric.

2025-07-24 12:20 Kaitlyn Nguyen: Implemented bounded local spool (256MB cap) with drop-oldest + metric audit_spool_dropped_total and audit_spool_size_bytes. Also documented operational behavior in pkg/auditlog/README.

2025-07-25 09:06 Ethan Park (Control-plane): One nit: please include the mutation "source" (console/api/admin-cli) and the resource name/ID. Also ensure we capture impersonation fields when support uses admin tooling.

2025-07-25 09:41 Kaitlyn Nguyen: Added source + resource_id and actor.impersonated_subject when present (existing header from admin gateway).

2025-07-25 11:12 Marcus Lin: Re-reviewed after changes. ✅ Approving.
2025-07-25 11:18 Jordan Lee: ✅ Approving.
2025-07-25 11:26 Sean Gallagher: ✅ Approving.
2025-07-25 11:33 Ethan Park: ✅ Approving.

2025-07-25 12:02 Kaitlyn Nguyen: Squash merge after green CI.
release_notes: - Internal: audit logging added for burst config changes and burst admission decisions (denies 100% logged; allows sampled).
security_considerations: Redacts sensitive fields; no prompts/keys logged. Config diffs are allowlisted to burst limit fields. Actor extraction supports impersonation attribution.
follow_ups: Enable audit.burst.enabled in staging and validate ingestion/indexing (tracked in ENG-4833 subtask).
Add dashboard panel for audit spool drops + suppression counters (owned by Observability).
Decide retention policy for burst audit decision events before GA.
